subject: POC trial acceptance playbook + toolchain integration
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finlysys.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-05T14:07:00-07:00
Subject: POC trial acceptance playbook + toolchain integration

Elena — thanks again for a productive demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into the trial: 

Summary of what we agreed
- 2-week sandbox trial started 10/08 with streaming chat + embeddings evaluation.
- Primary success criteria: (1) average p90 latency < 350ms on your representative queries, (2) semantic recall >= 88% on the 150-item test set, (3) cost per 1k tokens under your target as discussed.
- Integration scope: SDK-based streaming for chat (websocket); embeddings via batch API; tool-calling for lookup+ticket-creation.

Ownership & timeline (proposed)
- Finly: provide representative dataset, network egress test window, and a single engineering point-of-contact by 10/09.
- Redwood (Dev): provide SDK sample routes, streaming handshake example, and test keys by 10/08 (sandbox).
- Redwood (Irene/CS): success criteria spreadsheet and evaluation harness in Drive by 10/06.

Deliverables I attached: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (first pass), a network diagram request, and a short SDK routes doc. Please review and call out any blockers.

Next steps
1) Elena to confirm POC engineering lead and give expected query distribution by 10/09.
2) Dev to drop initial SDK streaming example and server callback sample into the sandbox repo by 10/08.
3) We run a short connectivity smoke test 10/09 morning (your timezone).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Finly_POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (spreadsheet), network_diagram_v2.png (PNG), redwood_sdk_routes.md (text)
From: Elena Soto <elena@finlysys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Finly Systems (Procurement) <procurement@finlysys.com>
Date: 2028-10-05T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial acceptance playbook + toolchain integration

Thanks Irene — this is helpful and matches what we discussed. Quick replies inline: 

- I'll be the primary engineering lead for the trial (Elena) and will loop in Ravi from infra for the network checks. Ravi should be available 10/09 for the smoke test.
- Dataset: we'll upload a 150-query sample and a 1k-document corpus to your Drive link by EOD 10/07.
- Success criteria: the latency target is fine, semantic recall target is okay but can we add a tolerance for exact-match on high-priority queries? Suggest we mark 20 queries as "high-priority exact match" with a pass threshold of 95%.

Procurement note: our SOW requires a short trial amendment (no cost) and an NDA clause for data retention; procurement copied for visibility.

Elena
Head of Product
Finly Systems
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@finlysys.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-10-06T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial acceptance playbook + toolchain integration

Elena — good to meet you on the call. I'll upload the SDK examples to the sandbox repo tonight. Couple of clarifications so we implement the minimal work for the trial: 

Tech clarifications
- Streaming: we'll provide a websocket-based streaming example that demonstrates chunked tokens + reconnect; route name: /v1/stream/chat.
- Embeddings: batch endpoint /v1/embeddings with CSV import example. We'll also include a small Python script to compute recall and MRR against your test set.
- Tool calling: we'll include a sample external-calls adapter for ticket creation (POST /v1/tools/ticket-create) and a secure callback pattern with HMAC validation.

Network notes for Ravi
- We'll need an egress allowlist for the sandbox IPs (listed in the attached network diagram). Can you confirm Ravi has the capacity to run iperf on 10/09?

Plan: I'll push the code + a short README and open a PR: redwood/sandbox/finly/poc by 10/08 23:59 PDT. If anything changes I'll update this thread.

-Dev
Senior Backend Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena@finlysys.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ravi Kumar <ravi@finlysys.com>, Finly Systems (Procurement) <procurement@finlysys.com>
Date: 2028-10-07T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial acceptance playbook + toolchain integration

Thanks Dev — that sounds great. Ravi confirmed iperf window on 10/09 09:30 PT. Procurement flagged only a single change (data retention clause) — I'll circulate the suggested language this afternoon.

One ask on tooling: can the streaming example include a small debug endpoint that returns current KV cache size and active request counts? That will help us reproduce the p90 numbers during the run.

Elena
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena@finlysys.com>
Date: 2028-10-09T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC trial acceptance playbook + toolchain integration

Quick internal follow-up after Ravi's smoke test this morning: connectivity looks good, small packet loss observed but within tolerance for now. We're green to start the sandbox run tomorrow (10/10).

Action items updated (I updated the Drive doc):
- Dev: include the KV-cache debug endpoint and add a flag to enable verbose tracing in the streaming client (due 10/09 EOD) — posted as PR #42.
- Lauren: please own the evaluation harness and add the 20 "high-priority" exact-match queries Elena requested; confirm metrics dashboard (p90, recall, MRR) by 10/10 morning.
- Irene: finalize success spreadsheet with pass/fail cells and runbook for escalation (done).

I'll send a short kickoff to Finly tomorrow with sandbox keys and run instructions.

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
